HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0001.title: Use tab bars for navigation

statement.en: Use a tab bar for navigation between app sections, not for actions.
statement.ja: tab barはapp section間のnavigationに使い、actionには使わない。

conditions: Use the separately reviewed toolbar alternative for controls that act on the current view.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0001.review_note: Made the navigation purpose concrete and separated the toolbar alternative.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0004.title: Avoid overflow tabs

statement.en: Avoid tab-bar overflow that hides tabs behind a More tab.
statement.ja: tabをMore tabの背後に隠すtab-bar overflowを避ける。

conditions: On iOS and iPadOS, limited horizontal space can turn the trailing tab into More and reduce hidden-content reachability and discoverability.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0004.review_note: Retained AVOID and the device-size and orientation mechanism that creates overflow.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0009.title: Avoid similar tab-label and content colors

statement.en: Avoid giving tab labels and content-layer backgrounds similar colors.
statement.ja: tab labelとcontent-layer backgroundに似たcolorを使うことを避ける。

conditions: With bright or colorful content, prefer a monochromatic tab bar or an accent color with sufficient visual differentiation.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0009.review_note: Retained AVOID and both source-supported differentiation alternatives.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0010.title: Prefer an iPadOS tab bar for primary navigation

statement.en: Prefer an iPadOS tab bar for access to the app's most-used sections.
statement.ja: appで最もよく使うsectionへのaccessにはiPadOS tab barを優先する。

conditions: For a more complex app, allow conversion to a sidebar for a wider set of navigation options.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0010.review_note: Recorded the frequent-access purpose and complex-app sidebar adaptation.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0011.title: Let people customize iPadOS tab bars

statement.en: Let people customize an iPadOS tab bar when the app has many sections.
statement.ja: appに多数のsectionがある場合はiPadOS tab barをcustomizeできるようにする。

conditions: Let people add frequently used items and remove less-used items.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0011.review_note: Recorded the many-section condition and separated the default tab-count target.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0012.title: Account for tvOS tab-bar scrolling

statement.en: Account for tvOS tab-bar scrolling, pinning, and focus-return behavior.
statement.ja: tvOS tab barのscrolling、pinning、focus-return behaviorを考慮する。

conditions: A single-main-view tab can scroll the bar offscreen; split-view screens keep it pinned; pressing Menu returns focus to the bar.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0012.review_note: Replaced vague generated wording with the three system behaviors and remote-control modality.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0013.title: Optionally customize tvOS tab-item fonts

statement.en: You may choose custom tvOS tab-item fonts, including a selected-item font.
statement.ja: selected-item fontを含むtvOS tab-item fontをcustomizeしてよい。

conditions: The surrounding source presents this as an available customization capability.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0013.review_note: Changed generated SHOULD to MAY because the source introduces the list with You can.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0014.title: Consider a sidebar inside a visionOS tab

statement.en: Consider a sidebar within a visionOS tab for deep secondary navigation.
statement.ja: deepなsecondary navigationにはvisionOS tab内のsidebarを検討する。

conditions: The app hierarchy is deep enough to need secondary navigation within a tab.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0014.review_note: Preserved MAY and separated the mandatory selection-invariance clause.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0015.title: Optionally customize tvOS tab-bar backgrounds

statement.en: You may specify a tint, color, or image for a tvOS tab-bar background.
statement.ja: tvOS tab-bar backgroundにtint、color、imageを指定してよい。

conditions: The surrounding source presents this as an available customization capability.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0015.review_note: Changed generated SHOULD to MAY because the source introduces the list with You can.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0016.title: Optionally customize tvOS item tints

statement.en: You may specify separate tvOS tints for selected and unselected tab items.
statement.ja: selectedとunselectedのtvOS tab itemに別々のtintを指定してよい。

conditions: The surrounding source presents this as an available customization capability.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0016.review_note: Changed generated SHOULD to MAY because the source introduces the list with You can.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0018.title: Consider a sidebar for complex information structures

statement.en: Consider a sidebar or sidebar-adapting tab bar for a complex information structure.
statement.ja: complexなinformation structureにはsidebarまたはsidebarへadaptするtab barを検討する。

conditions: More sections are needed than a simple tab bar can expose clearly.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0018.review_note: Separated the optional complex-hierarchy alternative from the tab-count rule.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0023.title: Use a navigation split view for a fixed sidebar

statement.en: Use a navigation split view for a fixed iPadOS sidebar without tab-bar conversion.
statement.ja: tab barへconvertしない固定iPadOS sidebarにはnavigation split viewを使う。

conditions: The design presents a sidebar without offering tab-bar conversion.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0023.review_note: Recovered the direct navigation-split-view alternative from the iPadOS note.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0024.title: Default customized iPadOS tab bars to five or fewer tabs

statement.en: Aim for five or fewer default tabs when people can customize an iPadOS tab bar.
statement.ja: iPadOS tab barをcustomizeできる場合はdefault tabを5件以下にすることを目指す。

conditions: The limit helps preserve continuity between compact and regular view sizes.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0024.review_note: Recovered the conditional numeric target and kept its Aim strength at SHOULD.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0025.title: Optionally add tvOS button icons

statement.en: You may add tvOS tab-bar button icons such as settings and search.
statement.ja: settingsやsearchなどのtvOS tab-bar button iconを追加してよい。

conditions: The surrounding source presents this as an available customization capability.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0025.review_note: Activated the omitted capability and preserved the surrounding You can strength.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0027.title: Provide a symbol and label for every visionOS tab

statement.en: Provide a symbol and text label for every visionOS tab.
statement.ja: すべてのvisionOS tabにsymbolとtext labelを提供する。

conditions: The symbol stays visible when collapsed, and the system reveals labels when people look at the tab bar.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0027.review_note: Activated the omitted symbol-and-label directive and recorded gaze-driven label reveal.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0028.title: Keep visionOS tab labels short

statement.en: Keep visionOS tab labels short enough to read at a glance.
statement.ja: visionOS tab labelを一目で読める短さに保つ。

conditions: The tab bar expands and reveals labels when people look at it.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0028.review_note: Recovered the explicit You need to directive and its at-a-glance purpose.
